# xcelsior_gpus (Data Source)

GPUs free to rent now, from the same placement snapshot launches use. Prices are per hour in millionths of the account currency.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "xcelsior_gpus" "all" {}

# The cheapest GPU free right now.
locals {
  prices   = [for g in data.xcelsior_gpus.all.gpus : g.price_per_hour_micros]
  cheapest = [for g in data.xcelsior_gpus.all.gpus : g if g.price_per_hour_micros == min(local.prices...)][0]
}

output "cheapest_gpu" {
  value = local.cheapest.gpu_model
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `gpu_model` (String) Only this GPU model (case-insensitive).
- `region` (String) Only GPUs in this region.

### Read-Only

- `gpus` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--gpus))
- `observed_at` (String) When the snapshot was taken.
